ladder.label: UNCONFIRMED TURN
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum just crossed down; 3-day crossed down). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up.

entry.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 425.86. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early reversal building (heads-up): MACD histogram turned up off a trough (pre-cross). These anticipate a low BEFORE full confirmation — earlier entry, but a higher false-alarm rate, so treat as a heads-up to watch closely, not a trigger yet.
ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量刚刚向下交叉；3 日线向下交叉）。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。

ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：未确认转向。大局（逆势）：看空。

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.

ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 未确认转向信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自筑底中翻转）。 信号强度：温和（评分 -19/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱未确认转向（+24）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✗ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 —
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

entry_signal.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry_signal.action: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 425.86. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry_signal.action_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 425.86 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

timing.next_trigger: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 425.86. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.

headline.en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
headline.zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.29 ± 0.26 — low / noisy precision. Sector anchor (XLI) reads duration-neutral (+0.01). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.29 ± 0.26——精度低／噪声。 板块锚（XLI）为久期中性（+0.01）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。

decision.headline: Constructive — building a base
decision.gloss: Improving, not yet a leader — building a base.
decision.gloss_zh: 正在改善但尚未领先——正在筑底。

trust.en: Event edge: insider buying (lone FDR survivor) + earnings-surprise PEAD context + revisions — a confluence read, not a standalone alpha
trust.zh: 事件驱动优势：内部人买入（唯一通过 FDR 的因子）＋盈利超预期 PEAD 背景＋评级调整 — 综合参考，非独立超额收益

regime.en: Mixed tape — balanced momentum / earnings edge
regime.zh: 混合行情 — 动量与盈利优势均衡

timing.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 425.86. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
timing.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 425.86 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

axes.label: earnings · insider · revisions
axes.label_zh: 盈利 · 内部人 · 评级调整

trend.label: Trend
trend.value_zh: 上行 · 较200日均线 +18% · 逆势
trend.gloss: Where price sits vs its 200-day average, and how strong the trend is (ADX).
trend.gloss_zh: 价格相对200日均线的位置，以及趋势强度（ADX）。

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.gloss_zh: 日线／3日／周线三个周期的动量方向。

rel_strength.label: Relative strength
rel_strength.gloss_zh: 相对行业的价格强度——参考。

valuation.label: Valuation
valuation.gloss: Cheap/rich vs the market — context, not a buy signal.
valuation.gloss_zh: 相对大盘的估值——参考，非买入信号。

quality.label: Quality
quality.gloss: Business durability — will it survive the hold.
quality.gloss_zh: 业务的持久性——能否撑过持有期。

positioning.label: Positioning
positioning.value_zh: 内部人卖出 · 做空 4% 流通
positioning.gloss: Insider buying (an edge) and short interest (a risk).
positioning.gloss_zh: 内部人买入（优势）与做空比例（风险）。

volatility.label: Risk & size
volatility.value_zh: 常见回撤 -11% · 极端 -37% · → 建议仓位 25%
volatility.gloss: Expected downside drives how big to size.
volatility.gloss_zh: 预期下行决定建议仓位大小。

ownership.label: Ownership & flow
ownership.value_zh: 1 家 13F 持有人 · 减仓中（1→0 家，4季）
ownership.gloss: Who owns it and how concentrated; multi-quarter 13F holder trend (lagged ~45d) + how many backtest-skilled funds are buying (descriptive context).
ownership.gloss_zh: 谁在持有、集中度如何；多季度 13F 持有人趋势（滞后约45天）以及有多少回测优质基金在买入（仅供参考）。

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.
macro.gloss_zh: 利率／通胀敏感度——参考，不计分。

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
